title: Can Retrievers Find the Same Paper from Different Aspects? A Multi-Aspect Full-Paper Scientific Retrieval Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.15624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific papers contain multiple searchable facets such as background, methods. However, many paper retrieval benchmarks merely evaluate individual query-paper relevance, while overlooking other facets of the same paper. To bridge this gap, we introduce MAPLE, an expert-validated benchmark for multi-aspect, full-paper retrieval that evaluates whether retrievers can consistently recover the same paper from queries targeting its motivation, method, and experimental findings. MAPLE contains 2,095 queries about recent ML and NLP papers, grounded in both textual and multimodal content. We further propose MAPLE-Synth, a retrieval-based in-context learning pipeline that leverages OpenReview discussions and human-written query exemplars to generate realistic queries reflecting researchers' interests in different aspects of a paper. translated_title: 检索器能否从不同方面找到同一篇论文？一个多方面的全文科学检索基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15624v1 公告类型：新 摘要：科学论文包含多个可检索的方面，如背景、方法等。然而，许多论文检索基准仅评估单个查询与论文的相关性，而忽视了同一论文的其他方面。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了MAPLE，一个经专家验证的多方面全文检索基准，用于评估检索器是否能从针对论文动机、方法和实验发现的查询中一致地恢复同一篇论文。MAPLE包含2095个关于近期机器学习和自然语言处理论文的查询，基于文本和多模态内容。我们进一步提出了MAPLE-Synth，一种基于检索的上下文学习流水线，利用OpenReview讨论和人工撰写的查询示例来生成反映研究人员对论文不同方面兴趣的逼真查询。我们的专家验证表明，这些查询在真实性方面与人工撰写的查询相当，且高度相关。
tldr: 我们提出了MAPLE基准和MAPLE-Synth流水线，用于评估检索器是否能在多方面的全文检索中从不同角度一致地找到同一篇论文，并通过专家验证确保查询的真实性。
en_tdlr: We introduce MAPLE benchmark and MAPLE-Synth pipeline to evaluate whether retrievers can consistently find the same paper from different aspects in multi-aspect full-paper retrieval, with expert validation ensuring query realism.
